positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Founded initial designs and shaped company brand; as well as, worked alongside designers to develop graphic and production materials to later further develop a strong UI and UX for the website.
• Worked on system network, monitoring server and data security, and performing routine updates; source controlling projects with Git
• Database structure written in SQL; front-end written in HTML, JavaScript, CSS, jQuery, JSON, AJAX, and PHP to handle e-commerce peripherals such as user information, customer orders, animations, and event handlers.
• Composed graphic design projects for different clientele using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator and other Adobe Creative Cloud software.
• Constructing RESTful API for all HTTP requests from websites to interact with the database.

positions.title: Driver Helper
positions.description:
• Assisted driver during loading and unloading of packages, delivering the products or packages to clients; as well as navigating drivers towards required destinations on time and recording delivery logs. • Reported issue(s) to higher officials or senior staff of the company regarding delays and resolving problems in appropriate manner.
• Managed and organized packages chronologically and numerical order to decrease work overflow and delay time.
• Delivered packages to warehouses, businesses, and residential areas.

positions.title: Information Technology Intern
positions.description:
• Served as the first line of support for internal users and responded to IT support requests or escalated problems to IT supervision when necessary.
• Worked on system network, monitoring server and data security, and performing routine updates; worked with Azure and VMWare software.
• Maintained, repaired, and upgraded hardware and software issues in a timely manner
• Moderated and standardized hardware including computer systems, phone system printers, and network devices.
• Provided technical support and guidance to users with hardware and software.
• Attained the confidentiality and security of Golden Empire Transit, Inc. data and documents.
• Validated IT team with ongoing and related projects (programming, database admin, and cable work, etc.)
positions.insights: Skills: Analytical Skills · Communication · Problem Solving

positions.title: Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Developed the company’s brand by designing displays and exhibits of various sizes for public spaces.
• Addressed deadlines in appropriate manner while creating advertisements, forms, brochures, quarterly newsletters, and other publications.
• Logos and artwork designed using Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator; as well as, other Adobe from Adobe Creative Cloud.
• Designing drafts and mock ups using Figma and Adobe XD; as well as; uploading and implementing logos on websites using front-end development languages such as HTML5/CSS3.
positions.insights: Skills: HTML · 2D art · Adobe Illustrator · Adobe Photoshop · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Client Requirements · Figma (Software)

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and maintained both front and back-end of the company website using HTML 5, CSS 3, MySQL, JavaScript, PHP, and AJAX to develop a strong UI and UX.
• Optimized SEO by reducing load time using algorithms, remodeled the layout and design, and standardized quality content; as well as, creating a responsive web design.
• Built an app for NDSP using JSON and MySQL to handle back-end mobile applications and used languages such as object-oriented JavaScript, jQuery and CSS to design the front-end. Furthermore, the project was source controlled using Git.
• Built and designed database infrastructure for national directory using MySQL and PhpMyAdmin. 
• Constructing RESTful API for all HTTP requests from websites to interact with the database.
